# pull has an error

Fix `pull` on hosts with an older git:

```bash
$ pull
error: unknown option `prune-tags'
```

`git-pull` ran `git fetch --all --prune --prune-tags --tags` before the pull; `--prune-tags` exists only since Git 2.17 (2018), and a machine with the system git (macOS shipped 2.15 on older releases, Ubuntu LTS likewise) rejected the whole fetch, so `pull` did nothing.

Expected: `pull` works with the git available on the machine, or the dotfiles make sure a recent git is installed first.
